---
name: bmad-bmm-quick-dev
description: Implement a Quick Tech Spec for small changes or features. Use when the user provides a quick tech spec and says "implement this quick spec" or "proceed with implementation of [quick tech spec]"
metadata:
  workpilot:
    # Not emitted until the BMAD runtime is present. These wrappers are
    # pointers into _bmad/, which is generated by BMAD's own installer
    # and gitignored -- so on a fresh clone they resolved to nothing and
    # every one of them failed on invocation.
    requires: { runtime: "_bmad/bmm/workflows/bmad-quick-flow/quick-dev/workflow.md" }
---

IT IS CRITICAL THAT YOU FOLLOW THIS COMMAND: LOAD the FULL @_bmad/bmm/workflows/bmad-quick-flow/quick-dev/workflow.md, READ its entire contents and follow its directions exactly!
